title: Bicycle
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Rear wheel -->
  <circle cx="26" cy="68" r="18" fill="none" stroke="#30e0ff" stroke-width="4"/>
  <circle cx="26" cy="68" r="3" fill="#30e0ff"/>
  <!-- Rear spokes -->
  <line x1="26" y1="50" x2="26" y2="86" stroke="#30e0ff" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.6"/>
  <line x1="8" y1="68" x2="44" y2="68" stroke="#30e0ff" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.6"/>
  <line x1="13" y1="55" x2="39" y2="81" stroke="#30e0ff" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.6"/>
  <line x1="39" y1="55" x2="13" y2="81" stroke="#30e0ff" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- Front wheel -->
  <circle cx="76" cy="68" r="18" fill="none" stroke="#30e0ff" stroke-width="4"/>
  <circle cx="76" cy="68" r="3" fill="#30e0ff"/>
  <!-- Front spokes -->
  <line x1="76" y1="50" x2="76" y2="86" stroke="#30e0ff" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.6"/>
  <line x1="58" y1="68" x2="94" y2="68" stroke="#30e0ff" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.6"/>
  <line x1="63" y1="55" x2="89" y2="81" stroke="#30e0ff" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.6"/>
  <line x1="89" y1="55" x2="63" y2="81" stroke="#30e0ff" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- Frame -->
  <line x1="26" y1="68" x2="46" y2="44" stroke="#ff5ec8" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="46" y1="44" x2="76" y2="68" stroke="#ff5ec8" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="46" y1="44" x2="32" y2="34" stroke="#ff5ec8" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="32" y1="34" x2="26" y2="68" stroke="#ff5ec8" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="26" y1="68" x2="46" y2="44" stroke="#ff5ec8" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="34" y1="50" x2="54" y2="50" stroke="#ff5ec8" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Seat tube to seat -->
  <line x1="32" y1="34" x2="28" y2="26" stroke="#ffd23f" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Seat -->
  <ellipse cx="26" cy="24" rx="9" ry="4" fill="#ffd23f"/>
  <!-- Handlebar stem -->
  <line x1="46" y1="44" x2="58" y2="28" stroke="#ffd23f" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Handlebars -->
  <path d="M50 26 Q58 22 64 28" fill="none" stroke="#ffd23f" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Pedal crank -->
  <circle cx="46" cy="68" r="4" fill="#ffd23f"/>
  <line x1="42" y1="64" x2="50" y2="72" stroke="#ffd23f" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Chain ring -->
  <circle cx="46" cy="68" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#ffd23f" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Pedals (little), front fork -->
  <line x1="76" y1="68" x2="70" y2="44" stroke="#b6ff5e" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="70" y1="44" x2="58" y2="28" stroke="#b6ff5e" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Little chain detail -->
  <path d="M46 75 Q36 78 26 68" fill="none" stroke="#b6ff5e" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
